Thanks again for the time today — great discussion on your latency and multi-region requirements. Quick recap:

- Primary constraints: sub-200ms p95 for short queries, strict audit logging, SSO via SAML.
- Next ask: 60–90m technical demo + ops deep-dive to validate deployment/SSO and discuss cost optimizations.

To make scheduling painless across your teams, we propose a rotating-demo cadence (alternating slots to accommodate US/EU/APAC):
- Option A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / Wed 18:00 CEST / Thu 02:00 SGT
- Option B (EU-friendly): Wed 14:00 CEST / Wed 06:00 PT / Thu 21:00 SGT
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Thu 09:00 SGT / Wed 01:00 PT / Wed 11:00 CEST

Attached is a short agenda and the SSO checklist to look over. Can you confirm which option works best for your group (or suggest 2–3 specific times)? I can set rotating calendar invites so we alternate slots weekly.

Thanks,
